hcti-open-graph-images 1.0.0

- Initial release of the hcti-open-graph-images skill.
- Provides instructions for configuring dynamic Open Graph images using HCTI’s hosted MCP server.
- Supports both page screenshot and reusable template rendering modes with detailed workflow guidance.
- Outlines secure OAuth-based setup via OpenClaw and integration steps for website deployment.
- Includes documentation for managing proxies, storage destinations, configuration updates, and troubleshooting.
